BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all ofthe RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 20-H in the area bounded by




A line 120.70 feet south of and parallel to West 86*" Street;


the alley next east of and parallel to South Marshfield Avenue;


a line 154.03 feet south of and parallel to West 86**' Street;


And South Marshfield Avenue.




to those ofa RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.




SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

9. Present Zoning District RS-3           Proposed Zoning District     RT-3.5


10. Lot size in square feet (or dimensions)   4,166.25 sq. ft.
11. Current Use of the property Two dwelling units with two car garage at the rear of property.


12. Reason for rezoning the property In order to allow an additional dwelling unit to be
established in the basement for a total of three-dwelling units; owner requested an ADU to
establish the basement unit and, however, was denied by DOH.


13. Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and
height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
Applicant proposes to establish an additional dwelling unit in the basement of the existing
794.04 sq. ft. two-story, two-dwelling unit with basement residential building for a total of three
dwelling units. Subject site is currently improved with a 408.04 sq. ft. two-car garage at the
rear of the property. Applicant also proposes to add a one vehicle parking pad to accommodate
the required parking for a total of three off-street parking spaces.


14. The Affordable Requkements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
